## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem your feature addresses.

## README & Roadmap Alignment

> **Note**: README.md is the single source of truth for the system design and architecture.

- [ ] This proposal aligns with the roadmap outlined in `README.md`.
- [ ] This proposal does NOT alter core invariants (single escrow contract holding USDC via SAC, states Pending/Refunded/Claimed, oracle-only confirm_reply, recipient-only flag_spam, permissionless claim after deadline + grace, only msg_hash on-chain).
